extName.message: cici — Claude in Chrome device ID
extName.description: Extension name, shown in the Web Store and on chrome://extensions.

extDesc.message: Tells you which Chrome profile each UUID in Claude Code's browser picker belongs to, starting with this profile's bridgeDeviceId.
extDesc.description: Web Store description, 132 characters or fewer.

appTitle.description: Product name in the popup header.

appSubtitle.description: One-line description in the popup header.

loadingHint.message: Scanning the browser profiles on this computer.

needFileAccessTitle.description: Title shown when the file access toggle is off.

needFileAccessWhy.message: The bridgeDeviceId lives inside your Chrome profile folder. Reading that file needs "Allow access to file URLs" turned on.

howToStep1.message: Open this extension's details page with the button below.

howToStep2.message: Turn on "Allow access to file URLs".

needFileAccessNote.message: Flipping that toggle makes Chrome reload the extension, so this popup closes the moment you do. You do not need to restart the browser — just open the popup again and it works.
needFileAccessNote.description: Note that the toggle reloads the extension.

copyUrl.description: Button that copies the chrome://extensions URL.

urlCopyHint.message: The popup closes when you press the button. You can also copy the address and paste it into a new tab.
urlCopyHint.description: Help text next to the copy button.

currentProfile.description: Section heading above the current profile card.

otherProfiles.description: Section heading for the remaining profiles.

badgeCurrent.description: Badge on the current profile card.

deviceIdLabel.description: Label above the UUID. Do not translate.

copyFailed.message: Could not copy. Please select the text and copy it yourself.

copyDeviceIdAria.description: Screen reader name for the current profile's UUID button.

copyOfAria.description: Screen reader name for a list row's copy button.

unnamedProfile.description: Shown when the profile name could not be read.

notPaired.description: The Claude extension is installed but has no bridgeDeviceId.

notPairedHint.message: Connect this browser to Claude Code once from the Claude extension and an ID is created.
notPairedHint.description: Help text for the not-paired state.

claudeNotInstalled.message: The Claude extension is not in this profile
claudeNotInstalled.description: No such folder under Local Extension Settings.

claudeNotInstalledHint.message: Install Claude in Chrome in this profile and its ID shows up here.
claudeNotInstalledHint.description: Help text for the not-installed state.

selfNotFoundTitle.message: Could not tell which profile this is
selfNotFoundTitle.description: Title when the nonce round trip failed.

selfNotFoundHint.message: Pick yours from the list below. This can happen when a profile folder cannot be read.
selfNotFoundHint.description: Help text when the current profile is unknown.

noProfilesTitle.description: Title when profile enumeration came back empty.

noProfilesHint.message: Check that file URL access is on and that your browser is installed in its default location.
noProfilesHint.description: Help text for the empty state.

noOtherProfiles.description: Shown when the current profile is the only one.

errorTitle.description: Title of the fatal error screen.

errorHint.message: Try "Scan again". If it keeps failing, please open an issue with the details below.
errorHint.description: Help text on the error screen.

retry.description: Retry button on the error screen.

warnSelfDetect.message: Could not determine the current profile: $DETAIL$

privacyNote.message: cici only reads files on this computer. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.
privacyNote.description: Footnote at the bottom of the popup.
